candidates.title: PHP2Shell: AI-assisted discovery of two critical PHP flaws; NSA says patch or go offline; sites worldwide taken offline (Oct 21-23)
candidates.summary: Two critical PHP flaws (CVE-2026-109618/109619, CVSS 9.2, unauthenticated RCE) found by Calif with OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and independently by Wiz; patches Oct 21 (8.5.12/8.4.27/8.3.36/8.2.35); NSA: patch now or take offline; governments & companies took sites offline; PHP ~70% of sites with known server language (W3Techs).
candidates.note: Escalated since Oct 21 (was a runner-up yesterday, never published). Confirmed by NPR, CNN, CNBC, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, Axios, TNW, BleepingComputer, Help Net Security, The Hacker News, CSA Singapore. Omitted: 'millions of exploit attempts' (number unconfirmed), 'decades old' (sources disagree), any how-to detail.
